paragraphs: SITA sells airport passenger processing software that moves a traveler from check-in through to boarding on common-use systems. The range covers Smart Path for identity management, Smart Path Kiosks, Smart Path Bag Drop and Smart Path Gates used for self-boarding, lounge access, security and border control. Flex Essentials is a common-use option for small and regional airports, and Flex as a Service is an API-based module for airlines.

A second group of products handles operations at airports, including flight information display, airport management and passenger information. Baggage products include Bag Journey for locating a bag, Bag Manager for reconciliation and WorldTracer for tracing mishandled bags.

These pages name airlines, airports and ground handlers as the users of the baggage and passenger products, and list governments among the industries served. Customer stories on the same page name Philadelphia International Airport, Geneva Airport and Shymkent International Airport.

quote.text: SITA Maestro provides airports, airlines and ground handlers with a more automated and cost-effective way for their agents to process an airline’s passengers
